Appendix/search and end-matter context, article pp. 54-64 (physical PDF pp. 56-66)

duplicate_review.note: Comparison-specific results repeated in the abstract/Summary of Findings were intentionally not atomized in this general batch to reduce cross-batch duplication.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom MVP is described as a primary-literature model, while this source is a systematic review. Review-level methods, disclosures, and protocol changes are represented with existing atom kinds and systematic_review/review_level tags.

There is no dedicated atom kind for systematic-review search architecture, certainty-assessment framework, update-status statements, or protocol-review changes; METHOD and OTHER are used where defensible.
GRADE certainty values are not represented as standalone structured fields in this general batch; comparison-specific GRADE findings are deferred to their quantitative extraction runs.
extraction_limitations: Pass 0 was used only as a routing/scaffold artifact; all atoms were anchored to the original CD006649 source rather than to Pass 0.
Background epidemiology and mechanism statements that depend on cited external literature were not atomized in this general review-level run.
No comparison-specific quantitative findings were extracted in this run because they are assigned to dedicated semantic batches.
Atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; no human verification status is asserted.
